```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Democrats believe every student deserves a quality education, regardless of their parents' zip code or income.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Children who attend preschool are nearly 50 percent more likely to finish high school and go on to earn a two- or four-year degree, no matter their background.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will provide free, universal preschool for four-year olds, saving the families of 5 million children $13,000 a year.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The American Rescue Plan made the biggest investment in public education in history, providing $130 billion to help 15,000 districts reopen, rebuild, and catch kids up.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Funding from the American Rescue Plan has worked to help children learn.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"The American Rescue Plan spurred long overdue improvements in school facilities and indoor air quality, creating safe and healthy learning environments for students and school staff.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"An additional $2 billion was provided to high-need, Title I schools.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Districts nationwide trained and hired 14,000 more counselors and social workers.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Increased investments in full-service community schools were made, five-fold, providing health care, nutrition, job training, and other wraparound services for kids at school.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
